From: Natalie Ramos <natalie.ramos@halebridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo — Halebridge / Redwood

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the flexibility on timing. Procurement has flagged a few gating items we need completed before we can attend the live demo: a countersigned NDA, completion of our vendor security questionnaire, and confirmation that Redwood can run the demo behind our SSO (we need to provision a read-only test account). Until those are cleared they won't approve a live walkthrough with any of our production data.

I've attached the vendor_questionnaire we use (IT/compliance will triage once you return answers). Our legal team prefers DocuSign for NDAs — can you send the Redwoods' standard NDA or confirm you can sign ours?

If we can't get those items done this week, we'll need to move the demo out. Our procurement indicated the week of Nov 29th is the earliest they're comfortable scheduling. Can you share a couple of options?

Thanks,
Natalie Ramos
Director, Vendor Management
Halebridge Health

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo — Halebridge / Redwood

Hi Natalie — thanks for the heads up and for sending the questionnaire. Totally understood on the gating items. We're happy to work through procurement requirements and we can do the following:

- Send a one-way executed NDA via DocuSign today (attached: NDA_draft.pdf) — let us know if you want us to sign your template instead.
- Karthik will coordinate answers to the vendor_questionnaire; we typically return completed questionnaires within 48 hours but we'll prioritize yours.
- If SSO provisioning will take longer, we can run an isolated demo on a sanitized tenant (no customer data) and show the integration flow; if you prefer the SSO-enabled walkthrough we'll hold until your IdP team completes the provisioning.

Would either of these slots work for a rescheduled demo the week of Nov 29?
- Tue, Nov 30 — 10:00–10:45am ET
- Wed, Dec 1 — 2:00–2:45pm ET

I'll put tentative invites on hold once we lock a slot. Lauren, can you own the commercial/contract thread once we confirm? Karthik, can you pick up the questionnaire and flag any technical blockers.

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: NDA_draft.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

Logan / Lauren — looping in some technical notes so we can turn around the questionnaire quickly. Quoting Natalie's email below.

Plan:
1) I'll complete the vendor_questionnaire answers today and upload them to the vendor intake portal (HB-4921).
2) Demo options if SSO not ready: spin up a sandbox tenant with redacted/sample data and prepare an SSO flow diagram to walk through how SSO would be configured (include estimated lead time for provisioning).
3) If Halebridge can provision a read-only test account before Nov 30, we can keep the Nov 30 slot; otherwise recommend moving to Dec 1 or Dec 6.

I've attached our internal demo_setup_checklist; it lists the minimum items we need to run a secure walkthrough without production access. Lauren, once Natalie confirms which NDA path they're taking, can you shepherd approvals and signature? I'll push the questionnaire answers into the portal and tag Procurement.

Thanks — Karthik
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
